definitions.explanation: Low in price. A somewhat old-fashioned usage.
Taking the easy way without much thought or effort. Often carries a critical nuance of being too simple-minded or lazy in approach.

examples.japanese: {安直|あんちょく}な⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}えた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I was able to buy it at a cheap price.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{安直|あんちょく}な⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧な。
examples.english: I wonder if there's a cheaper shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安直|あんちょく}だった。
examples.english: Prices used to be cheap around here in the old days.

examples.japanese: {安直|あんちょく}な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
{安直|あんちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧べきで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't jump to a conclusion too easily.

examples.japanese: {安直|あんちょく}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you rely on an easy approach, you'll end up regretting it later.

notes: Sense 1 (cheap/inexpensive) is somewhat dated and rarely used in modern conversation. Sense 2 (easy/simplistic) is the more common modern usage and almost always carries a negative nuance — it criticizes a lack of serious thought or effort. Common collocations: {安直|あんちょく}な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ (simplistic thinking), {安直|あんちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think too simply), {安直|あんちょく}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (an easy/lazy method).
